issues.description: The Developer.attend method signature in the solution repository does not match the signature specified in the problem statement and provided in the template. The problem and template expect func attend(course: Course?) (single parameter). The solution implements func attend(course: Course?, forCredit: Bool) (an extra parameter) but the solution's Client calls attend(course:) with a single argument. This creates a structural mismatch across artifacts and also an internal inconsistency in the solution (call site vs. definition), which would prevent the code from compiling and confuse students about the intended method signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the attend method signature consistent across all artifacts. Either (A) change the solution's Developer.attend definition to func attend(course: Course?) and update its implementation accordingly so it matches the problem statement and template, or (B) if the extra parameter is intentional, update the problem statement and template to document the additional forCredit: Bool parameter and update all call sites (e.g. Client) to pass that argument or provide a default value for the new parameter. Option A is recommended to preserve the educational intent.

issues.description: The problem statement and template expect a Developer method attend(course:) (single parameter). The solution repository implements attend with a different signature attend(course:forCredit:) (an extra parameter). This mismatch in the method signature for the same conceptual operation (a developer attending a course) creates a mapping confusion: students looking at the solution will find a method that does not match the required attend(course:) API and may be unsure which signature is correct.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution's Developer.attend signature match the problem statement and template by removing the extra parameter. Change the solution implementation to func attend(course: Course?) { ... } (or alternatively update the problem statement and template to require the extra forCredit parameter consistently across all artifacts).
